decision.title: sxml validate (packet )
decision.summary: sxml validate validates each FILE in one pass through a validator over the null builder, uses only the schemas named by required --schema options, never following location hints, and reports in text or JSON.

body.p: . The command of the 5.10 design (docs/tasks/phase-5.md), in apps/sxml/command_validate.c; golden apps/sxml/command_check.c. Public API only (schema.h, xml.h).

item.p: One pass per FILE: the XML parser feeds a validator whose result builder is the null builder; the processor and its local-file resolver are query_command.h's (SXML_PARAMETER_BINDING_NONE). SCHEMA documents are TEXT documents with file URIs, so includes and imports resolve relative to the referring document; report locations are named back by sxml_query_file_of_uri, moved with sxml_query_make_file_uri from command_transform.c to query_command.c (one helper for both commands).

Schema location hints are not followed, and there is no flag for them. The schema is what the command line names (: the command line fully determines behaviour; XSD 1.1 Part 1, 4.3.2 leaves hints to the processor; schema.h does not follow them either). A hinted document is named with another --schema. An explicit flag can be added later if the owner wants one; it would be a second, visible way to name schema documents, never a default.

Required options in the CLI framework: SXML_CLI_OPTION_AT_LEAST_ONCE (cli_command.h) is a repeatable option the parser requires (SXML_CLI_USAGE_ERROR_MISSING_OPTION, "missing option '--schema'"); help shows --schema=SCHEMA [--schema=SCHEMA]... and "(required; repeatable)", so the usage line and docs/CLI.md agree.

Reports: text errors go to standard error as they arrive; JSON keeps a file's errors in an arena until its object is written, so comes before errors. A description that starts with its constraint name (the facet errors of ) is shown without it. In text, a file whose validity is not known gets one line on standard error. A FILE the parser rejects is reported as sxml check does; a failure of the validator (a limit, UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE of the 5.8 and 5.9 seams) is failed, exit 4.
Deviation from the design: a document an include names that cannot be read is reported as src-resolve where its components are used, not src-include (, XSD 1.1 4.2.3 clause 2.4); docs/CLI.md says so.
WebAssembly: the CLI module grows to 4,877,565 bytes stripped (1,126,567 gzipped); its ctest budget is raised to 5,500,000 / 1,250,000 and the growth reported under "Proposed".

Measured: the instance tests of msData/particles (ms-Particles_w3c, 514 run by both) give the same validity through sxml validate as through sxml-xsd-test, the 16 that need location hints with the hinted documents passed as --schema.
